notes: Deployment-specific command-echo contract. Preserve raw values; physical-range and timestamp quality gates apply. Approval does not transfer to new hardware.

action_semantics.source: Piper CAN control-target echo, not independently measured master-arm posture
action_semantics.joint_conversion: Recorded driver uses millidegrees / 1000 * 0.017444 for command joints; preserve its published values without rescaling.
action_semantics.timestamp_semantics: ROS publication time; does not prove freshness of the underlying CAN command

state_semantics.gripper_conversion: micrometres / 1000000; full opening, not one finger displacement

clock_policy.scope: timestamp units, source and host epoch reviewed; not a hardware synchronization certification
clock_policy.state: SocketCAN receive timestamp propagated by Piper SDK; driver max(joint, high-speed-feedback) timestamp
clock_policy.action: robot ROS system clock at publication; use_sim_time=false
clock_policy.cameras: Orbbec device timestamps; enable_sync_host_time=true on all three cameras; driver syncs host clock at startup and every 30 seconds
clock_policy.resampling: 30 Hz; nearest RGB bounded by 20 ms; causal joint hold bounded by 50 ms; gaps remain errors

limits_policy.source: Installed piper_sdk C_PiperParamManager default nominal joint limits and gripper_range
limits_policy.scope: dataset position QC only; not firmware limit calibration or a motion-control safety envelope
limits_policy.note: Do not expand nominal limits to fit observed out-of-range samples. Verify calibration/hardware variant before a future policy revision.

verification.method: read-only review of conversion app, recorder, installed driver and SDK; live read-only ROS parameters and publisher identity; uploaded raw sample inspection
limitations: Existing test capture has constant all-zero action and static feedback.
Published action timestamps do not expose CAN target freshness.
Nominal gripper range differs from observed 0.083 m; keep quality rejection.
verification.publication_note: Deployment audit paths, device aliases and capture fingerprints omitted from the source snapshot.
